provenance.method: Generated for structcorpus from the published yamlprims specification revision 1.3, section 6, with the limits of the yamlprims-core-limits r1 profile.

review.author: devlead
review.rationale: Inputs whose node count or owned-byte weight is one below, equal to, and one above the profile's max_nodes and max_owned_bytes, where each retained shorthand tag is a wrapper node weighing 64 plus its uri, handle, and suffix bytes. Only the input above the limit fails, with that limit named. Bound to the revision 1.3 profile; expectations are identical to the revision 1.1 recipe because no input in this set is affected by 1.2/E-1 to E-3 or 1.3/E-1 to E-4.
